nodes.name: .slim/deepwork/ui-upgrade.md
nodes.summary: Planning document for a phased UI refactor of the voxlblade app, proposing extraction of the repetitive modal system, a toast/notification system, the app header, and consolidation of CSS design tokens into app.css to shrink App.svelte.

nodes.name: analyze-mounticon.mjs
nodes.summary: Standalone debug script that reads src/MountIcon.svelte and prints the length plus first/last chunks of its SVG path data so the mount icon shape can be inspected.

nodes.name: decode_full.mjs
nodes.summary: Standalone debug build decoder that loads all game data JSON files and reconstructs final equipment stats by applying upgrade scaling, enchantment selectors, shrines and infusions, mirroring engine constants for validation.

nodes.name: applyUpgrade
nodes.summary: Scales positive stat values up by 1 + level*0.1 and negative values down by the same factor to model weapon upgrade tiers.

nodes.name: computeSelectorBaseMult
nodes.summary: Iterates enchantment names in reverse and computes the base stat multiplier contributed by positive, negative and defense stat selectors.

nodes.name: applyDirectEnchantModifiers
nodes.summary: Applies flat stat modifiers from equipped enchantments on top of the selector-derived base multipliers for a slot.

nodes.name: applyEnchantmentsToSlot
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a full enchantment application for one equipment slot by chaining selector base multipliers, upgrade scaling and direct modifier application.

nodes.name: finalizePerks
nodes.summary: Merges raw perk entries collected from equipped items and enchantments into a final perk map, exempting internal keys and converting potion-style entries.

nodes.name: docs/ONBOARDING.md
nodes.summary: Onboarding guide describing voxlblade's architecture layers (config, source, data, engine, modals, stores), the damage calculation pipeline, component hierarchy and a file map with complexity hotspots.

nodes.name: src/app.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet defining the dark-theme design tokens (colors, surfaces, fonts, radii, shadows, z-indexes) and draconic theme variables consumed by every Svelte component.

nodes.name: src/App.svelte
nodes.summary: Root Svelte component orchestrating the entire app: build-state editors (race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon, enchant selection with drag-and-drop), and the damage analyzer, buff list, level bar, emotional tracker and build saves.

nodes.name: src/BaseDamageCalc.svelte
nodes.summary: Core damage calculator component that turns computed hits into per-type damage breakdowns, handling dark-magic hex conversion, crit values, lifesteal, DoT colors and badge configs, and rendering per-hit rows for the analyzer.

nodes.name: src/BuffList.svelte
nodes.summary: Displays and manages the active buff/debuff list for the current build, deriving buffs from equipped items, potions, perks and weapon arts, applying warding multipliers and letting the user toggle effects.

nodes.name: src/BuildSaves.svelte
nodes.summary: Implements build save/load/export/import with localStorage slots, a search index over saved items, confirmation modals and toast feedback.

nodes.name: src/CdrStepsCalc.svelte
nodes.summary: Renders cooldown reduction as a chain of multiplication steps (rune or weapon-art breakdown) with the final floor and CD minimum cap applied, including an optional set-bonus override.

nodes.name: src/CritIcon.svelte
nodes.summary: Tiny SVG component rendering a gradient crit star/bolt glyph at a configurable size with a unique per-instance gradient id.

nodes.name: src/DamageAnalyzer.svelte
nodes.summary: Primary damage analysis interface (~7.5k lines) computing the full damage pipeline — weapon/monk scaling, typed boosts, DoTs, procs, buffs, debuffs, defenses, self-damage perks, draconic runes and stance overlays — and rendering breakdowns with toggles.

nodes.name: src/data/draconicRunes.ts
nodes.summary: Data/calculation module for the Draconic Runes and Dragon Infusion buff systems, providing apply/get helpers that modify or read per-element damage-type bonuses based on rune stacks and infusion potency.

nodes.name: applyDraconicRunesBonus
nodes.summary: Adds 0.05 * stack count to the current draconic element's damage type in a copy of the damage map when rune stacks are positive.

nodes.name: getDraconicRunesBonus
nodes.summary: Returns the bonus damage contribution from Draconic Runes as a {element: bonus} map, empty when no stacks are active.

nodes.name: applyDragonInfusionBonus
nodes.summary: Adds the infusion potency to the draconic element's damage type in a copy of the damage map when the infusion buff is active.

nodes.name: getDragonInfusionBonus
nodes.summary: Returns the damage bonus from Dragon Infusion as a {element: potency} map, empty when the buff is inactive.

nodes.name: applyDraconicBonuses
nodes.summary: Exported helper that applies both Draconic Runes and Dragon Infusion bonuses onto a damage-type map in sequence.

nodes.name: getDraconicBonuses
nodes.summary: Exported helper that combines the read-style bonuses from both Draconic Runes and Dragon Infusion into a single element-to-bonus map.

nodes.name: src/data/potions.ts
nodes.summary: Static data module listing the potion options (Rage Potion and Poison Potion) with descriptions and colors, plus a name-to-potion lookup map.

nodes.name: src/data/selfDamagePerks.ts
nodes.summary: Defines self-damage perk metadata (Undead Might, Explosive Charge, Dark Magic, Bombardier, Steam Powered) and calcSelfDamage, which computes self-inflicted damage by type with DR, multi-target falloff and flat proc handling.

nodes.name: calcSelfDamage
nodes.summary: Computes total and per-type self damage for a perk given its damage percentage, defense multipliers, enemy count (harmonic falloff) and hit count, supporting flat proc-based damage.

nodes.name: src/data/stanceOverlays.ts
nodes.summary: Defines stance-overlay rules (Blaster Ring, Locked And Loaded, Cosmic Ray, Mine) that map build conditions to a resolved weapon-art stance type, exported via resolveStanceOverlay.

nodes.name: resolveStanceOverlay
nodes.summary: Returns the first matching stance overlay result (type and M2 behavior) for a given build context, or null when no overlay applies.

nodes.name: src/DidYouMean.svelte
nodes.summary: Shows 'Did you mean?' suggestion chips when a search returns no exact results, dispatching the selected label and highlighting matched text parts.

nodes.name: src/DmgTotalTooltip.svelte
nodes.summary: Tooltip component rendering a per-hit damage breakdown grouped by damage type with an animated pie chart, badge configs per entry and percentage share of the hit total.

nodes.name: src/DraconicAbilityStats.svelte
nodes.summary: Small stat display panel for draconic abilities showing damage type, scaling, poise damage and optional holy/water heal rows.

nodes.name: src/EmotionalTracker.svelte
nodes.summary: UI control for selecting the character's emotional state (buff/debuff/both) via quick buttons and a segmented slider, writing the selection into the build store and reflecting a disabled flag.

nodes.name: src/Highlight.svelte
nodes.summary: Utility component that splits text into highlighted/unhighlighted parts matching a query using highlightTextParts and renders matched segments inside a mark element.

nodes.name: src/LevelBar.svelte
nodes.summary: Interactive level and HP-fill editor synced to the build store and localStorage, computing effective max HP from protection (shield/negative) values and letting the user drag the HP bar.

nodes.name: src/lib/AppHeader.svelte
nodes.summary: App shell header with an animated Overview/Analyze tab navigation (including keyboard Tab switching) and hosting the BuildSaves component.

nodes.name: src/lib/constants/boosts.ts
nodes.summary: Constants module exporting 60+ tuning values for boost calculations, including per-stack multipliers for many perks, frenzy/heal values, and Heat Drill and Essence Ray parameters.

nodes.name: src/lib/constants/cdr.ts
nodes.summary: Constants module exporting cooldown-reduction tuning values (percentages, per-stack reductions, set bonuses) for various runes, weapon arts and set effects.
